MOST TRADERS FAIL FOR ONE SIMPLE REASON

They enter when the market is quiet 
and exit when the market is active.

The market rewards patience, not excitement.

If price is slow → wait. 
If price is emotional → wait more. 
If price is clear → then act.

Trading is not about doing more trades.
It’s about doing less, but at the right time.

I am finally done for the day. 
I am not a religious person but today for sure something was on my side 🙈🙈 
I was holding sells from yesterday while it was spiking up like hell, I still held and in between I was scalping sell and buys for daily profits , My drawdown was going up to minus 13 k , struggling to make the decision I will hold max to minus 15 k and I will close not more than that , but luckily it didn’t go that high and the waterfall started , I managed up and down scalps and had a 1k profit for the day . Meanwhile closing some of my entries in profits , some in small loss, some breakeven and at the end I closed everything and took a loss for the day of 691 which I am extremely happy , to be honest I was never happy for a loss of a day like today from 13 k minus to 691 minus wow 😮 
When I look at my weekly profit I am at 4829.22 in profit so worked out really well .i am now relaxed and off to cook some dinner ,😀 wish everyone a nice evening and weekend. Next week is a new week of profit making 🥰
